messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired for service metering-ingest-consumer (sev: high)
incident-bot: reason: consumer group lag > 10k offsets for topic usage-events, offset skew detected, ingestion falling behind >= 7m
incident-bot: Pager: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

PagerDuty: Pager triggered -> INCIDENT INC12345 created by monitoring

Ellen (oncall): acking. I'm on it.

Jamal (sre): on it with Ellen. pulling consumer lags...
Jamal (sre): ```bash
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka1:9092 --describe --group metering-consumer
# lag: 11524 partitions with high lag
``` 

Maya (eng-infra): autoscaler shows no new pods because consumer-group partition assignment stuck on node gpu-7
Maya (eng-infra): checking node taints and pod events

Alex (billing): heads up - this could cause invoice undercount for events in the last 20m. estimating impact...
Alex (billing): initial check: ~25 customers with >1000 token delta risk. marking for potential invoice delay

Ellen (oncall): restarting metering-consumer pod on node gpu-7 to force rebalance
Ellen (oncall): ```bash
kubectl -n ingest rollout restart deploy/metering-consumer
kubectl -n ingest delete pod metering-consumer-5f4d7
``` 

Jamal (sre): restart succeeded, consumer group rebalanced, lag dropping
Jamal (sre): ```text
lag per partition: 11524 -> 2400 -> 300 -> 0 (rolling)
``` 

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 acknowledged by Ellen (oncall)

Alex (billing): thanks. can we confirm no tokens lost, just delayed?
Maya (eng-infra): looking at offsets and retention, no data deletion. looks like ingestion delay only.

Liz (product): any customers impacted with live ingestion features? could be support outreach.
Alex (billing): a small cohort (25) may see missing usage rows in the invoice preview; billing team to hold invoices for affected accounts until backfill completes.

Ellen (oncall): scheduling backfill job for the gap window 2026-03-14T01:12Z -> 2026-03-14T01:32Z
Ellen (oncall): backfill started, progress ~40%

Jamal (sre): mitigation verified. lag stable at 0, ingestion throughput normal.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: Mitigated -> monitoring

Ellen (oncall): handing off to night oncall @Nina for watch and to finish backfill. See runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/metering-ingest

Nina (oncall-night): acked. I'll monitor and escalate if backfill fails.

Alex (billing): follow-up: filing an invoice-risk ticket, will coordinate refunds/holds if needed. ETA for backfill completion ~30m.

Liz (product): creating postmortem placeholder. tagging owners.

Ellen (oncall): notes to postmortem: root cause likely consumer partition assignment stuck on node with ephemeral disk pressure + autoscaler threshold edge-case. follow-ups: add healthcheck, improve autoscaler policy, alert to partition stuck > 2m.

incident-bot: pager update: no active alert for INC12345. manual follow-up required: ticket MTR-789

Ellen (oncall): closing thread here. any objections?

Alex (billing): none. thanks team :thumbsup:
